## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Add coverage for adopting an already-matching setting, because that boundary’s change reporting and file rewrite behavior remain unchecked. This review read the complete diff, both changed files, and all existing tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request adds an adoption option that updates existing settings and records adopted keys, while retaining replacement behavior. It adds tests for adoption and replacement with different values.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/config.py:13 — tests — Test adoption of already-matching settings — For `{"theme":"dark"}` with incoming `{"theme": "dark"}` and `adopt=True`, no test exercises the equal-value adoption boundary. Your adoption test changes `"light"` to `"dark"`, while the existing equal-value test uses `replace=True`; neither checks adoption’s unconditional change recording and resulting file rewrite. — Regressions in change reporting and file preservation for already-matching adopted settings have no test protection.
